coverage_notes.search_limitations: Search engine results leaned heavily toward older 2025 SNAP shutdown, routine listings, and preannounced store closures. Indexing lag, social-only cancellation notices, and four inaccessible agency pages constrain recall. A no-findings result is not proof no disruption exists.
